title: Tools
format: html
number-sections: false
---

How to use the tools that research software is run, stored, tracked, and served
with, whatever the language it is written in. The documents are organized by
job, not by tool, so that the tools that do the same job can be compared, and a
document outlives a change of tool. Each tool has a document of its own. A job
with a link has one more, which compares its tools and states the rules that
hold for all of them.

| Job | Tools |
|-----|-------|
| Cloud computing | [AWS](cloud/aws.qmd) ![](../logos/aws.svg){.logo} |
| [Containers](containers/index.qmd) | [Apptainer](containers/apptainer.qmd) ![](../logos/apptainer.svg){.logo}, [Docker](containers/docker.qmd) ![](../logos/docker.svg){.logo} |
| Data formats and storage | [Parquet](data/parquet.qmd) ![](../logos/parquet.svg){.logo}, [HDF5](data/hdf5.qmd) ![](../logos/hdf5.svg){.logo}, [Zarr](data/zarr.qmd) ![](../logos/zarr.svg){.logo} |
| Experiment tracking | [MLflow](tracking/mlflow.qmd) ![](../logos/mlflow.svg){.logo} |
| HPC scheduling | [Slurm](scheduling/slurm.qmd) ![](../logos/slurm.svg){.logo} |
| Services | [FastAPI](services/fastapi.qmd) ![](../logos/fastapi.svg){.logo} |
| Version control and CI | [Git](version-control/git.qmd) ![](../logos/git.svg){.logo}, [GitHub Actions](version-control/github-actions.qmd) ![](../logos/github-actions.svg){.logo} |
| [Workflow managers](workflows/index.qmd) | [Nextflow](workflows/nextflow.qmd) ![](../logos/nextflow.svg){.logo}, [Snakemake](workflows/snakemake.qmd) ![](../logos/snakemake.svg){.logo} |

Like a language document, a tool document mixes rules, which carry the
[normative language](../principles/design.qmd#sec-normative) of *Design
Principles* and apply its principles, with reference to look up while working.
Tools change faster than principles and languages, so each document says which
versions of the tools it was last checked against.
